meta.description: Add Telegram channel integration via Chat SDK.

copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果想给应用增加聊天消息渠道
copy.tagline_en: Add Telegram chat to your existing app
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to add a chat channel to your app.

howto.what: 装上后 Claude 会把 Telegram 适配器连同配对、Markdown 清洗辅助代码和测试复制进项目，注册到频道入口，安装指定版本的依赖包，构建并跑一次注册测试，然后带你创建 Bot 并用 4 位配对码绑定聊天。
howto.when: 当你想给 NanoClaw 项目接入 Telegram 频道，或在 /setup 流程中要配好 Telegram 时使用。

say.text: 帮我给这个项目加上 Telegram 频道集成
say.note: 会复制适配器并安装指定版本依赖

say.text: 怎么用 BotFather 创建 Telegram 机器人？
say.note: 会给出创建步骤并要求你粘贴令牌

say.text: 我的 Telegram 配对码是多少？
say.note: 运行配对步骤并打印 4 位数字码

howto.what_en: Copies the Telegram adapter, its pairing and markdown helpers and tests into your project, registers it in the channel barrel, installs the pinned package, builds and runs one test, then guides you through bot creation and pairing.
howto.when_en: Use when you want to add Telegram as a channel to your NanoClaw project, or while running /setup and wiring up Telegram.

say_en.text: Add Telegram channel integration to this project.
say_en.note: Copies the adapter and installs the pinned package.

say_en.text: How do I create the Telegram bot with BotFather?
say_en.note: Gives BotFather steps and asks for the bot token.
Runs the pairing step and prints a 4-digit code.
